spec_features.spec_quote: submit is the only clean terminator, and its description explicitly invites the agent to say so if it cannot complete the task
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: submit ToolSpec description 'Finish the task... If you cannot complete the task, say so plainly here.'; _submit raises SubmitSignal(answer); agent_loop.py: except SubmitSignal -> transcript.stop_reason='submitted'; submitted=True; break. So the tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: submit is genuinely the clean terminator and its description invites bailing out. Note this is the agent's own exit, not a host-side protective cap; still end-to-end enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns (25): bounds cost and provides a natural "ran out of road" outcome
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: 'for _turn in range(config.max_turns):' with a 'else: transcript.stop_reason = "max_turns"' clause; LoopConfig.max_turns=25 (config.example.yaml max_turns: 25). The loop actually terminates when the count is exhausted.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced hard stop on turn count.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns (25): bounds cost (DESIGN prose only); in code the LoopConfig comment 'anti-loop guard' is for repeat_limit; max_turns itself has no code comment beyond bounding the loop -> cost-oriented, instrumental

spec_features.spec_quote: a model that just talks without acting has effectively stopped; treating it as a terminal state avoids spinning empty turns
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: 'if not response.tool_calls: # Model emitted prose with no action; treat as a soft stop. transcript.stop_reason = "no_tool"; break'. Actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced terminal state when no tool call is emitted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model emitted prose with no action; treat as a soft stop. (efficiency: avoids spinning empty turns)

spec_features.spec_quote: Tool execution catches exceptions and returns them to the model as error results rather than crashing the loop
spec_features.evidence: tools.py ToolExecutor.execute: 'except Exception as e:  # surface tool errors to the model rather than crashing' -> returns ToolResult(is_error=True). run_eval.py: per-cell try/except writes '.error.txt' with comment '# never let one cell kill the whole sweep'.
spec_features.notes: Both the per-tool catch and the orchestrator-level catch are implemented and active.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # surface tool errors to the model rather than crashing / # never let one cell kill the whole sweep

spec_features.spec_quote: runs bash with that dir as cwd and a command timeout (default 30s)
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py Sandbox.__init__(command_timeout=30); run() calls subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.command_timeout) and catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired returning returncode=124, timed_out=True. run_eval.py wires cmd_timeout=int(config.get('command_timeout_s',30)) into Sandbox(command_timeout=cmd_timeout).
spec_features.notes: Default 30s, configurable, enforced via subprocess timeout and handled.
